name: VRM_REV_DOC_LINE_SPLITS_ALL
description: VRM_REV_DOC_LINE_SPLITS_ALL contains revenue split information, which allows users to distribute revenue line amounts into multiple lines. For example, user may want to split the revenue line amount by salesperson or other attributes (example, cost center). The information is used as an input for SLA's accounting creation process.

columns.description: Unique identifier for the revenue split line.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date that will be used for revenue split.

columns.name: SPLIT_BASIS
columns.description: Reasons for the revenue line split.  Two seeded values are Salesperson and Manual.

columns.description: Amount of the revenue line for this split line.

columns.name: SPLIT_PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of the revenue line amount for this split line.

columns.name: SPLIT_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Revenue split line number.
